## When channels aren't the answer

For protecting shared in-memory state (caches, counters), a `sync.Mutex` is simpler than channels.

## WaitGroup

Wait for a set of goroutines to finish. `Add` before starting, `Done` in a defer, `Wait` to join.

## Once and RWMutex

`sync.Once` guarantees one-time init. `sync.RWMutex` allows many readers or one writer. The `-race` detector finds data races.
